notes_for_editor: Single source: the tnlandforms Georgia tower list (entry GA112). Two web searches found no fire lookout in Gwinnett County; the results were water towers and unrelated fire towers, and none is cited. No cached NHLR, FFLOS or eastern-lookout page mentions this tower. The datasheet code DF2743 is not explained by the page, which cites NGS data sheets; a search for the code found nothing relevant. The list prints no unit for elevation; the record converts it as feet, which the story follows. Nothing is known about build date, staffing, fate or access. Checks worth making: NGS datasheet lookup for DF2743; Gwinnett County historical sources; the NHLR and FFLOS registers if a listing exists.
